info.title: Foodly API
info.description:
## 🍔 Foodly API Documentation

Welcome to the official interactive documentation for **Foodly REST API**

tags.name: Authentication & Users
tags.description: User registration, authentication, session management, and profile retrieval

tags.name: Restaurants
tags.description: Restaurant catalog, top rating spotlights, and restaurant administration

tags.name: Food
tags.description: Menu items, pricing, availability, and food administration

bearerAuth.description: Enter your JWT token in the format: Bearer <token>

description.example: Authentic Mediterranean cuisine and fresh seafood
Fresh fish, shrimp, and seafood specialties

food.description: Virtual populated food items in this category

description.example: Fresh Atlantic salmon with garlic herb butter and steamed asparagus

message.example: Invalid Input Data. the name is required

limitQuery.name: limit
limitQuery.description: Maximum number of items returned per page

sortQuery.name: sort
sortQuery.description: Field to sort by. Prefix with '-' for descending order (e.g. `-rating`).

fieldsQuery.name: fields
fieldsQuery.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response (e.g. `name,rating`).

post.description: Registers a new user account with an uploaded avatar image. Encrypts password with bcrypt and returns a JWT authentication token.

avatar.description: User profile avatar image file (JPEG, PNG, etc. MIME type must begin with 'image/')

400.description: Validation error, non-image file, or email already registered

value.message: Invalid Input Data. the name is required. Please enter a valid email

post.description: Authenticates user with email and password. Sets an HTTP-only cookie named `token` (valid for 90 days) and returns the JWT in the response body.

get.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's profile information based on decoded JWT token.

value.message: Invalid Token. Please log in and try again
Your session has expired. Please log in again

get.description: Alias route that automatically applies `limit=5` and sorts descending by rating (`sort=-rating`). Also supports optional query parameters for field selection and regex address search.
Retrieves restaurants matching query filters with sorting, field selection, and pagination.

post.description: Creates a new restaurant. Requires **admin** role.

description.example: Authentic Mediterranean cuisine and fresh seafood

example.message: Invalid Input Data. Restaurant must has a name. Restaurant must has a description

403.description: Forbidden - User is not an admin

get.description: Retrieves a single restaurant by its MongoDB ObjectId, populating virtual `category` references with their `name`.

example.message: No document found with that ID

patch.description: Updates fields of an existing restaurant. Requires **admin** role.

description.example: Renovated fine dining with fresh seafood

delete.description: Deletes a restaurant document by ID. Requires **admin** role.

get.description: Retrieves all categories matching query filters with sorting, field selection, and pagination.

post.description: Creates a new category. Requires **admin** role.

description.example: Fresh fish, shrimp, and seafood specialties

example.message: Invalid Input Data. Category must has a name. Category must have a description

get.description: Retrieves a category by ID, populating virtual `food` items with `name`, `price`, and `rating`.

patch.description: Updates an existing category. Requires **admin** role.

description.example: Fresh fish, shrimp, and charcoal-grilled dishes

delete.description: Deletes a category by ID. Requires **admin** role.

get.description: Retrieves all food items with sorting, filtering, field selection, and pagination. Category and restaurant details are automatically populated.

post.description: Creates a new food item. Minimum price is $5. Requires **admin** role.

description.example: Fresh Atlantic salmon with garlic herb butter and steamed asparagus

400.description: Validation error (e.g. price below 5, missing name)

example.message: Invalid Input Data. Price Must be atleast 5$

get.description: Retrieves a single food item by ID. Populates category (`name`) and restaurant (`name address`).

patch.description: Updates fields of an existing food item. Requires **admin** role.

description.example: Fresh Atlantic salmon with garlic herb butter and grilled veggies

delete.description: Deletes a food item by ID. Requires **admin** role.

204.description: Food item deleted successfully (No Content returned)
